import pandas as pd

# Define source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_39/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_39/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_39/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_39/training_3.csv"
]

# Read all source tables into a list of DataFrames
dfs = []
for file in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file, index_col=0)
    # Ensure columns order matches target schema ['label', 'x', 'y']
    # Source schema is ['x', 'y', 'label'], so reorder and convert types accordingly
    df = df[['label', 'x', 'y']]
    # Convert 'label' to string type explicitly
    df['label'] = df['label'].astype(str)
    # Convert 'x' and 'y' to integer by rounding (since target schema expects integer)
    df['x'] = df['x'].round().astype(int)
    df['y'] = df['y'].round().astype(int)
    dfs.append(df)

# UNION operation: concatenate all source DataFrames
target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Reorder columns to match target schema explicitly (already done, but to be safe)
target_df = target_df[['label', 'x', 'y']]

# Write the result to the target CSV file
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_39/target_multisource.csv", index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source CSVs with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
df0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_39/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_39/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
df2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_39/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
df3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_39/training_3.csv", index_col=0)

# UNION all source tables
df_union = pd.concat([df0, df1, df2, df3], ignore_index=True)

# Group by 'label' and aggregate x and y by rounding and converting to int
df_grouped = df_union.groupby('label', as_index=False).agg({
    'x': lambda col: int(round(col.mean())),
    'y': lambda col: int(round(col.mean()))
})

# Rename columns to match target schema exactly (already matched)
# Write output CSV
df_grouped.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_39/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
